description: Continue an owned review-mode world or model preview into final generation, either by asset_id or by the latest preview in chat_id. Use this when the user intentionally chose review mode or is continuing an existing preview-ready asset. Errors: INVALID_TARGET (no asset found), INVALID_STAGE (asset exists but is not preview-ready; response includes currentStatus and nextActions).
name: approve_final_generation
title: Approve Final Generation
